title: Metallic / iridescent
identify: Gold, silver, copper, or rainbow-like highlights.
recognition: Reflective colour shifts and metal-like sheen.

confused_with.difference: Single-photo lighting can imitate metallic effects; ordinary gloss is a strong reflection without metallic colour.
